blocks.en: Congestion Control Implementation
blocks.zh_html: 拥塞控制实现

blocks.en: Recap: TCP Windows
blocks.zh_html: 回顾：TCP 窗口(Recap: TCP Windows)

blocks.en: So far, we’ve designed a conceptual sketch of a dynamic adjustment, host-based algorithm, where each source runs the same algorithm independently to arrive at an efficient, fair share of bandwidth.
blocks.zh_html: 到目前为止，我们已经设计了一个动态调整的、基于主机的算法的概念草图，其中每个发送方独立运行相同的算法，以达到高效、公平的带宽分配。

blocks.en: First, use slow-start (start at low rate, exponentially increase) to discover an initial rate. Then, in each iteration, if we detect congestion (detect loss), we reduce R multiplicatively. If we don’t detect congestion, we increase R additively.
blocks.zh_html: 首先，使用慢启动(slow-start，从低速率开始，指数增加)来发现初始速率。然后，在每次迭代中，如果检测到拥塞(检测到丢失)，我们乘法减少 R；如果没有检测到拥塞，我们加法增加 R。

blocks.en: In this section, we will now see how TCP implements this algorithm. For better or worse, TCP’s congestion control mechanisms are very intertwined with TCP’s reliability mechanisms. (This is a result of the original design, where TCP was patched to account for congestion.) In this section, we’ll see how TCP’s implementation works to achieve both reliability and congestion control at the same time.
blocks.zh_html: 在本节中，我们将看到 TCP 如何实现这个算法。不论好坏，TCP 的拥塞控制机制与 TCP 的可靠性机制紧密交织在一起。(这是原始设计的结果，当时 TCP 被修补以应对拥塞。)在本节中，我们将看到 TCP 的实现如何同时实现可靠性和拥塞控制。

blocks.en: Recall that in TCP, the sender maintains a sliding window of consecutive bytes/packets in flight. The size of the window is determined by flow control (decided by buffer space at recipient) and congestion control (rate computed by sender).
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，在 TCP 中，发送方维护一个连续的字节/分组的滑动窗口(sliding window)，其中包含在途(in flight)的数据。窗口的大小由流量控制(flow control，取决于接收方的缓冲区空间)和拥塞控制(congestion control，由发送方计算的速率)共同决定。

blocks.en: More specifically, in flow control, the recipient sends an advertised window, indicating how many more bytes can be sent without overflowing the recipient’s memory. This advertised window value is sometimes abbreviated RWND (receiver window).
blocks.zh_html: 更具体地说，在流量控制(flow control)中，接收方发送一个通告窗口(advertised window)，指示在不溢出接收方内存的情况下还可以发送多少字节。这个通告窗口值有时缩写为 RWND (receiver window)。

blocks.en: In congestion control, the sender maintains a value, sometimes abbreviated CWND (congestion window), which denotes the rate the sender can send packets without overloading links. This value will be dynamically set and adjusted by the congestion control algorithm.
blocks.zh_html: 在拥塞控制中，发送方维护一个值，有时缩写为 CWND (congestion window)，表示发送方在不使链路过载的情况下可以发送分组的速率。这个值将由拥塞控制算法动态设置和调整。

blocks.en: The sender’s window is computed as the minimum of CWND and RWND. For this lecture, we’ll assume that RWND is larger than CWND, so the bottleneck is the network, not the recipient’s memory. This is usually, but not always true in practice.
blocks.zh_html: 发送方的窗口计算为 CWND 和 RWND 的最小值。在本讲中，我们假设 RWND 大于 CWND，因此瓶颈(bottleneck)是网络，而不是接收方的内存。这在实践中通常是成立的，但并非总是如此。

blocks.en: Recall that we can view the sliding window as a range in the bytestream. The left side of the window is the first unacknowledged byte (everything to the left of the window has already been sent and acknowledged). The right side of the window is determined by the window size. Only packets inside this window are allowed to be in-flight.
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，我们可以将滑动窗口(sliding window)视为字节流(bytestream)中的一个范围。窗口的左侧是第一个未确认的字节(窗口左侧的所有内容都已被发送和确认)。窗口的右侧由窗口大小决定。只有窗口内的分组才允许在途(in-flight)。

blocks.en: When data on the left side of the window is acked, the window slides to the right, and additional data can now be sent.
blocks.zh_html: 当窗口左侧的数据被 ack 时，窗口向右滑动，此时可以发送更多数据。

blocks.en: To detect loss, we maintain a single timer for the left-most packet in the window. If the timer expires without that packet being acked, we re-send the left-most packet in the window. Also, to detect loss, we count the number of duplicate acks, and re-send the left-most packet if we see 3 duplicate acks. This duplicate ack-based approach is sometimes called fast retransmit.
blocks.zh_html: 为了检测丢失，我们为窗口中最左侧的分组维护一个单独的定时器(timer)。如果定时器到期时该分组仍未收到 ack，我们就重传窗口中最左侧的分组。此外，为了检测丢失，我们统计重复 ack(duplicate ack)的数量，如果看到 3 个重复 ack，就重传最左侧的分组。这种基于重复 ack 的方法有时称为快速重传(fast retransmit)。

blocks.en: Windows and Rates
blocks.zh_html: 窗口与速率(Windows and Rates)

blocks.en: How do we adjust the rate for congestion control, and how do we compute the congestion window? It turns out that these two values are directly related, and adjusting the window is achieved by adjusting the rate. The window size and the rate of sending data are correlated by the following equation: rate times RTT = window size.
blocks.zh_html: 我们如何调整拥塞控制的速率？又如何计算拥塞窗口(congestion window)？事实证明这两个值直接相关，调整窗口是通过调整速率来实现的。窗口大小和发送数据的速率通过以下等式关联：速率乘以 RTT 等于窗口大小。

blocks.en: Intuitively, you can think of window size and rate as the same quantity, expressed in two different “units of measurement.” An increased window size means we’re sending data faster, and vice-versa.
blocks.zh_html: 直观上，你可以把窗口大小和速率视为同一个量，用两种不同的“度量单位”表示。窗口增大意味着我们发送数据更快，反之亦然。

blocks.en: To see why this equation holds, consider the first RTT. We can send [window size] number of packets during this first RTT (before any acks arrive), for a rate of window size / RTT.
blocks.zh_html: 为了理解这个等式为什么成立，考虑第一个 RTT。我们可以在第一个 RTT 期间(在任何 ack 到达之前)发送[窗口大小]个分组，速率为 window size / RTT。

blocks.en: Recall that our conceptual TCP design measured data in packets for simplicity, but in practice, TCP thinks in terms of bytes. In a real implementation, the window size is measured in terms of bytes, but for simplicity, we will consider the window size in terms of packets.
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，为简单起见，我们的概念性 TCP 设计以分组(packet)为单位度量数据，但在实践中，TCP 以字节(byte)为单位思考。在真实实现中，窗口大小以字节度量，但为简单起见，我们以分组为单位来考虑窗口大小。

blocks.en: To convert between packets and bytes, recall that we defined the Maximum Segment Size (MSS), the number of bytes per packet. This tells us that MSS times number of packets = number of bytes. Again, intuitively, you can think of bytes and packets as two different units of measurement for the same quantity (amount of data).
blocks.zh_html: 为了在分组和字节之间转换，回忆一下我们定义了最大段大小(Maximum Segment Size, MSS)，即每个分组的字节数。这告诉我们 MSS 乘以分组数等于字节数。同样，直观上你可以把字节和分组视为同一个量(数据量)的两种不同度量单位。

blocks.en: Event-Driven Updates
blocks.zh_html: 事件驱动的更新(Event-Driven Updates)

blocks.en: In our conceptual model, our goal is to adjust the rate/window once per “iteration,” but we haven’t formalized how to measure each iteration. We can roughly define each iteration as one RTT, but the RTT itself is a dynamically changing value that we can’t accurately measure.
blocks.zh_html: 在我们的概念模型中，目标是每“迭代”调整一次速率/窗口，但我们还没有形式化如何度量每次迭代。我们可以粗略地将每次迭代定义为一个 RTT，但 RTT 本身是一个动态变化的值，我们无法精确测量。

blocks.en: In order to update the window size in a more predictable, measurable way, we can consider the various events that the existing TCP implementation responds to, and update the window each time one of these events occurs. These are called event-driven updates.
blocks.zh_html: 为了以更可预测、可测量的方式更新窗口大小，我们可以考虑现有 TCP 实现会响应的各种事件，并在这些事件发生时更新窗口。这称为事件驱动的更新(event-driven updates)。

blocks.en: The three TCP events where we need to update the window size are: new ack, 3 duplicate acks, and timeout.
blocks.zh_html: 我们需要更新窗口大小的三个 TCP 事件是：新 ack(new ack)、3 个重复 ack(3 duplicate acks)和超时(timeout)。

blocks.en: When we see a new ack (for data that was previously not acknowledged), this is a sign that our data made it through the network without loss. In our model, we detect congestion by checking for loss, so a new ack is a sign that the network is not congested. Therefore, when we see a new ack, we can increase the window size (either during slow-start discovery, or AIMD adjustment).
blocks.zh_html: 当我们看到一个新 ack(针对之前未确认的数据)时，这表示我们的数据已无丢失地通过网络。在我们的模型中，我们通过检查丢失来检测拥塞，因此新 ack 表示网络没有拥塞。因此，当我们看到新 ack 时，可以增加窗口大小(无论是在慢启动发现阶段还是 AIMD 调整阶段)。

blocks.en: When we see 3 duplicate acks, we mark a packet lost. This is a signal of isolated loss, which indicates mild congestion. We lost a packet, but subsequent packets are still being received. To react to this loss, we will decrease the window size (during AIMD adjustment).
blocks.zh_html: 当我们看到 3 个重复 ack 时，我们标记一个分组已丢失。这是孤立丢失(isolated loss)的信号，表示轻度拥塞。我们丢失了一个分组，但后续分组仍在被接收。为了应对这种丢失，我们将减小窗口大小(在 AIMD 调整阶段)。

blocks.en: When we encounter a timeout, we mark a packet lost. The fact that we detected the loss after a timeout, not duplicate acks, is a signal of many packets being lost (heavy congestion). To see why, consider a window size of 100 packets. If we encounter a timeout, this means we didn’t get an ack for the left-most packet in the window. But it also means that we failed to get 3 duplicate acks for any other packets in the window during the entire duration of the timer. A timeout means that very few, if any, packets are being received, and something bad has happened.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们遇到超时(timeout)时，我们标记一个分组已丢失。我们是在超时后而非通过重复 ack 检测到丢失，这一事实是许多分组丢失(严重拥塞)的信号。为了理解原因，考虑一个大小为 100 个分组的窗口。如果遇到超时，这意味着我们没有收到窗口中最左侧分组的 ack。但这也意味着在定时器的整个持续时间内，我们没有收到窗口中任何其他分组带来的 3 个重复 ack。超时意味着几乎没有分组(如果有的话)被接收，发生了某种严重问题。

blocks.en: If we discover a timeout, something unexpected has happened (e.g. network changed), and we should no longer trust our current window size. To react, we should go back to the slow-start phase and re-discover a good window size. This isn’t the only way to react to timeout, but this is what TCP decided.
blocks.zh_html: 如果发现超时，说明发生了意外情况(例如网络发生变化)，我们不应再信任当前的窗口大小。作为应对，我们应该回到慢启动阶段，重新发现一个合适的窗口大小。这不是应对超时的唯一方式，但这是 TCP 采用的方式。

blocks.en: Event-Driven Slow Start
blocks.zh_html: 事件驱动的慢启动(Event-Driven Slow Start)

blocks.en: In our conceptual model, we implemented slow start by choosing a slow rate, and increasing the rate exponentially (e.g. doubling on each iteration) until we encounter the first loss. We now need an event-driven way to double the window once per RTT.
blocks.zh_html: 在我们的概念模型中，我们通过选择一个较低的速率并指数式增加(例如每次迭代翻倍)来实现慢启动，直到遇到第一次丢失。我们现在需要一种事件驱动的方式，使窗口每 RTT 翻倍一次。

blocks.en: TCP starts with a small window of 1 packet. Recall, we can convert packet to bytes with the maximum segment size (MSS), and then convert bytes to rate by dividing MSS/RTT.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 从 1 个分组的小窗口开始。回忆一下，我们可以用最大段大小(MSS)将分组转换为字节，然后通过 MSS/RTT 将字节转换为速率。

blocks.en: Every time we get an acknowledgement, we will increase the window size by 1 packet. The intuition for what will happen is:
blocks.zh_html: 每次收到确认(acknowledgement)，我们都会将窗口大小增加 1 个分组。直觉上会发生的情况是：

blocks.en: Initially, the window size is 1 packet. We send 1 packet, and after an RTT, get 1 ack back. The ack lets us increase the window to 2 packets.
blocks.zh_html: 最初，窗口大小为 1 个分组。我们发送 1 个分组，一个 RTT 后收到 1 个 ack。这个 ack 让我们将窗口增加到 2 个分组。

blocks.en: We now send 2 packets, and after an RTT, we get 2 acks back. The 2 acks let us increase the window by another 2 packets, for a new window size of 4 packets.
blocks.zh_html: 我们现在发送 2 个分组，一个 RTT 后收到 2 个 ack。这 2 个 ack 让我们将窗口再增加 2 个分组，新窗口大小为 4 个分组。

blocks.en: We now send 4 packets, and after an RTT, we get 4 acks back. The 4 acks let us increase the window by another 4 packets, for a new window size of 8 packets.
blocks.zh_html: 我们现在发送 4 个分组，一个 RTT 后收到 4 个 ack。这 4 个 ack 让我们将窗口再增加 4 个分组，新窗口大小为 8 个分组。

blocks.en: This intuitive picture assumes we are sending all 4 packets and receiving all 4 acks simultaneously, though. In practice, the sliding window behavior causes our window to increase by 1 each time we receive an ack, though the end behavior (doubling the window every RTT) is the same.
blocks.zh_html: 不过，这个直观画面假设我们同时发送全部 4 个分组并同时收到全部 4 个 ack。在实践中，滑动窗口行为使得我们每次收到一个 ack 时窗口增加 1，但最终行为(每 RTT 窗口翻倍)是一样的。

blocks.en: As before, we start with a window size of 1 packet. We send 1 packet (A), and after an RTT, get the ack for A back. The ack lets us increase the window to 2 packets, and there are zero packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 和之前一样，我们从 1 个分组的窗口大小开始。发送 1 个分组(A)，一个 RTT 后收到 A 的 ack。这个 ack 让我们将窗口增加到 2 个分组，此时在途分组为零。

blocks.en: Next, we can send out 2 packets (B and C). When we get the ack for B, we increase the window to 3 packets. There is still 1 packet in flight (C), so we can send 2 more packets (D and E).
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们可以发送 2 个分组(B 和 C)。当收到 B 的 ack 时，我们将窗口增加到 3 个分组。仍然有 1 个分组在途(C)，因此我们可以再发送 2 个分组(D 和 E)。

blocks.en: When we get the ack for C, we can increase the window to 4 packets. There are still 2 packets in flight (D and E), so we can send 2 more packets (F and G).
blocks.zh_html: 当收到 C 的 ack 时，我们可以将窗口增加到 4 个分组。仍然有 2 个分组在途(D 和 E)，因此我们可以再发送 2 个分组(F 和 G)。

blocks.en: In general, assuming no loss and no re-ordering, every time we receive an ack, the sliding window allows us to send one more packet, and the increased window allows us to send another packet. Because every ack leads to 2 packets being sent, we get the behavior where the window doubles every RTT. For example, within an RTT interval where we receive 16 acks, each ack triggers to packets being sent, for a total of 32 packets. Then, in the next RTT interval, those 32 packets will be acked, triggering 64 packets being sent.
blocks.zh_html: 一般来说，假设没有丢失和乱序，每次收到 ack 时，滑动窗口允许我们多发送一个分组，而窗口的增加又允许我们发送另一个分组。因为每个 ack 导致 2 个分组被发送，我们就得到了窗口每 RTT 翻倍的行为。例如，在一个 RTT 间隔内我们收到 16 个 ack，每个 ack 触发 2 个分组的发送，共 32 个分组。然后，在下一个 RTT 间隔内，这 32 个分组会被确认，触发 64 个分组的发送。

blocks.en: Eventually, after some time spent doubling the window every RTT (increasing the window by 1 for every ack), we’ll encounter loss. This also means we’ve learned the maximum allowable “safe” rate for sending packets without encountering loss. We’ll remember this rate in a new parameter called SSTHRESH (slow start threshold). Specifically, as soon as we encounter packet loss, we’ll set SSTHRESH to half the window size. For example, if a window of 16 packets doesn’t cause loss, but a window of 32 packets does cause loss, then we would set SSTHRESH to 16.
blocks.zh_html: 在窗口每 RTT 翻倍一段时间后(每收到一个 ack 窗口增加 1)，我们最终会遇到丢失。这也意味着我们学到了在不遇到丢失的情况下发送分组的最大允许“安全”速率。我们将这个速率保存在一个称为 SSTHRESH (slow start threshold)的新参数中。具体来说，一旦遇到分组丢失，就将 SSTHRESH 设为窗口大小的一半。例如，如果 16 个分组的窗口不会引起丢失，但 32 个分组的窗口会引起丢失，那么我们就将 SSTHRESH 设为 16。

blocks.en: Recall that after slow start, we will continually adjust the window size (AIMD). SSTHRESH lets us remember the safe rate we learned from slow start, even as the rate starts changing later.
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，慢启动之后我们会持续调整窗口大小(AIMD)。SSTHRESH 让我们记住从慢启动中学到的安全速率，即使后来速率开始变化。

blocks.en: Implementing Additive Increasing
blocks.zh_html: 实现加法增加(Implementing Additive Increasing)

blocks.en: In our conceptual model, after slow start, we want to slowly (additively) increase the rate when there’s no loss. We need an event-driven way to increase the window by 1 packet for each RTT.
blocks.zh_html: 在我们的概念模型中，慢启动之后，我们希望在无丢失时缓慢(加法地)增加速率。我们需要一种事件驱动的方式，使窗口每 RTT 增加 1 个分组。

blocks.en: We don’t have an exact number for the RTT, but we do know that within a single RTT, we expect a window’s worth of packets to be acked. For example, with window size 10, we receive 10 acks per RTT. If we increase the window by 1/10 packet per ack, then across a RTT, the window should increase by 1 packet, as desired.
blocks.zh_html: 我们没有 RTT 的精确数值，但我们知道在一个 RTT 内，预期会有一个窗口大小的分组被确认。例如，窗口大小为 10 时，每 RTT 收到 10 个 ack。如果我们每个 ack 使窗口增加 1/10 个分组，那么在一个 RTT 内，窗口应增加 1 个分组，正如所愿。

blocks.en: Each time we receive an acknowledgement, we will take the current window size CWND and reassign it to CWND + (1/CWND). This increases the window by a fraction of a packet on each ack. After a full window’s worth of packets (i.e. after one RTT), the window increases by 1 packet.
blocks.zh_html: 每次收到确认时，我们将当前窗口大小 CWND 重新赋值为 CWND + (1/CWND)。这样每个 ack 使窗口增加一个分片的量。经过一个完整窗口的分组(即一个 RTT)后，窗口增加 1 个分组。

blocks.en: Formally, TCP measures the window in bytes, not packets, so (1/CWND) is equivalent to MSS * (MSS/CWND) in bytes. In (1/CWND), the numerator is 1 packet (total increase in an RTT), and the denominator is CWND measured in packets. Since the denominator is now measured in packets, we also have to measure the numerator in packets: 1 packet = MSS bytes.
blocks.zh_html: 形式化地说，TCP 以字节而非分组为单位度量窗口，因此 (1/CWND) 等价于 MSS * (MSS/CWND) 字节。在 (1/CWND) 中，分子是 1 个分组(一个 RTT 内的总增加量)，分母是以分组计量的 CWND。由于分母现在以分组计量，我们也必须用分组计量分子：1 个分组 = MSS 字节。

blocks.en: But the fraction 1/CWND or MSS/CWND is still a ratio (dimensionless), representing the fraction to be increased on each ack. The total increase we want is 1 packet = MSS bytes, so we have to multiply this fraction by MSS bytes.
blocks.zh_html: 但分数 1/CWND 或 MSS/CWND 仍然是一个比值(无量纲)，表示每个 ack 应增加的比例。我们想要的总增加量是 1 个分组 = MSS 字节，所以我们必须将这个分数乘以 MSS 字节。

blocks.en: As an example, suppose our CWND was 3 packets = 150 bytes (assuming MSS = 50 bytes). In the packet view, we would add 1/3 packets to the window each time, for a total increase of 1 packet.
blocks.zh_html: 举个例子，假设我们的 CWND 是 3 个分组 = 150 bytes(假设 MSS = 50 bytes)。在以分组为单位的视角中，我们每次向窗口加 1/3 个分组，总共增加 1 个分组。

blocks.en: In the byte view, we can divide MSS/CWND = 50/150 to get the same 1/3 ratio that we need to step by each time, for a total increase of 1. But we still need to multiply by MSS so that the total increase is MSS instead of 1.
blocks.zh_html: 在以字节为单位的视角中，我们可以计算 MSS/CWND = 50/150 来得到同样的 1/3 比例，这就是每次需要增加的步长，总增加量为 1。但我们仍然需要乘以 MSS，使得总增加量为 MSS 而不是 1。

blocks.en: Note that the increase isn’t perfectly linear, but provides a good enough approximation. For example, starting with CWND = 4, the first update is 4 + 1/4 = 4.25, and the second increase is 4.25 + 1/4.25 = 4.49. After four updates, the window size would be 4.92 in this approximation (we wanted it to be 5 in the exact model).
blocks.zh_html: 注意，增加并非完全线性，但提供了足够好的近似。例如，从 CWND = 4 开始，第一次更新是 4 + 1/4 = 4.25，第二次增加是 4.25 + 1/4.25 = 4.49。四次更新后，窗口大小在这个近似中为 4.92(在精确模型中我们期望它为 5)。

blocks.en: Implementing Multiplicative Decrease
blocks.zh_html: 实现乘法减少(Implementing Multiplicative Decrease)

blocks.en: If we detect loss from 3 duplicate acks, we divide the window size by 2.
blocks.zh_html: 如果我们从 3 个重复 ack 检测到丢失，就将窗口大小除以 2。

blocks.en: Recall that if the retransmission timer expires, we interpret the timeout as multiple packets being lost (we didn’t even get duplicate acks). We assume that the current window might be way off, and in order to be cautious, we’ll rediscover a good rate from scratch.
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，如果重传定时器(retransmission timer)到期，我们将超时解释为多个分组丢失(我们甚至没有收到重复 ack)。我们假设当前窗口可能完全错误，为了谨慎起见，我们将从头重新发现一个合适的速率。

blocks.en: First, we’ll make a note that the current rate is too high, and the best known safe rate is half of our current rate (following the multiplicative decrease principle). To record this safe rate, we’ll set SSTHRESH to half the current window.
blocks.zh_html: 首先，我们要记录当前速率过高，已知的最佳安全速率是当前速率的一半(遵循乘法减少原则)。为了记录这个安全速率，我们将 SSTHRESH 设为当前窗口的一半。

blocks.en: Then, we’ll set the window size back to 1 packet, and repeat the slow start process again.
blocks.zh_html: 然后，我们将窗口大小重置为 1 个分组，并重新进行慢启动过程。

blocks.en: Note that when we re-try slow start, we need to be careful not to return to the dangerous rate with timeouts from earlier. Fortunately, we set SSTHRESH to be just below the dangerous rate. Therefore, in subsequent slow start re-trys (where SSTHRESH is set), as soon as our window exceeds SSTHRESH, we should switch from multiplicative to additive increasing. On the first slow start, SSTHRESH is unset (or infinity).
blocks.zh_html: 注意，当我们重新尝试慢启动时，需要小心不要回到之前导致超时的危险速率。幸运的是，我们将 SSTHRESH 设置在略低于危险速率的位置。因此，在后续的慢启动重试(SSTHRESH 已被设置)中，一旦我们的窗口超过 SSTHRESH，就应从乘法增加切换到加法增加。在第一次慢启动时，SSTHRESH 未设置(或为无穷大)。

blocks.en: To summarize: In slow-start, we increase the window by 1 packet for each ack (results in doubling the rate on each RTT). When in AIMD, we increase the window by a fraction of the window size for each ack (results in increasing by 1 for each window’s worth of data). We decrease the window by halving it when receiving 3 duplicate acks, and changing it to 1 on a timeout.
blocks.zh_html: 总结：在慢启动中，每个 ack 将窗口增加 1 个分组(结果是每 RTT 速率翻倍)。在 AIMD 中，每个 ack 将窗口增加窗口的一个分数(结果是每窗口数据增加 1)。收到 3 个重复 ack 时将窗口减半，超时时将窗口设为 1。

blocks.en: Note that when decreasing, we never drop the window size to less than 1 packet. In the worst case, we need to allow 1 packet to be in-flight.
blocks.zh_html: 注意，在减少时，我们绝不会将窗口大小降到 1 个分组以下。在最坏情况下，我们需要允许 1 个分组在途。

blocks.en: TCP Sawtooth
blocks.zh_html: TCP 锯齿波(TCP Sawtooth)

blocks.en: If we plot rate over time, we see the initial exponential growth (slow start). As soon as we experience loss, we cut the rate in half, and switch to AIMD mode. Now, we increase linearly until we encounter loss, and we halve the rate each time we encounter loss.
blocks.zh_html: 如果我们绘制速率随时间的变化图，会看到初始的指数增长(慢启动)。一旦遇到丢失，我们将速率减半，并切换到 AIMD 模式。之后，我们线性增加直到遇到丢失，然后每次遇到丢失时都将速率减半。

blocks.en: Fast Recovery: Running Example
blocks.zh_html: 快速恢复：运行示例(Fast Recovery: Running Example)

blocks.en: There’s one final problem we have to deal with in our congestion control implementation. When we encounter an isolated packet loss, the congestion window is halved, as intended. However, this has the unintended side effect of causing the sender to stall for some time before it can continue sending packets.
blocks.zh_html: 在我们的拥塞控制实现中，还有一个最终问题需要处理。当遇到孤立分组丢失(isolated packet loss)时，拥塞窗口按预期减半。然而，这有一个意外的副作用：发送方在能够继续发送分组之前会停滞一段时间。

blocks.en: To see this in action, let’s consider a running example. We send 10 packets, numbered 101 through 110. The first packet (101) is dropped.
blocks.zh_html: 为了看到这一点，让我们考虑一个运行示例。我们发送 10 个分组，编号为 101 到 110。第一个分组(101)被丢弃。

blocks.en: As a result, the other 9 packets, 102 through 110, are all acked as ack(101), because the next expected byte is still 101.
blocks.zh_html: 结果，其他 9 个分组(102 到 110)都被确认为 ack(101)，因为下一个期望的字节仍然是 101。

blocks.en: After the third duplicate ack(101) (generated by receiving 102, 103, and 104), the sender re-sends 101.
blocks.zh_html: 在第三个重复 ack(101)(由收到 102、103 和 104 产生)之后，发送方重传 101。

blocks.en: Eventually, the ack for the re-sent 101 arrives. It says ack(111), because packets 102 through 110 were all received earlier, and with the receipt of 101, the next expected byte is 111.
blocks.zh_html: 最终，重传的 101 的 ack 到达。它报告 ack(111)，因为分组 102 到 110 之前都已收到，而随着 101 的收到，下一个期望的字节是 111。

blocks.en: To summarize: At the sender’s end, we send 101 through 110, and 101 gets dropped. We get ack(101) from 102, ack(101) from 103, and ack(101) from 104. At this point, we re-send 101. Then, we get ack(101) from 105 through 110. Finally, we eventually get ack(111) from 101.
blocks.zh_html: 总结：在发送方，我们发送 101 到 110，101 被丢弃。我们从 102 收到 ack(101)，从 103 收到 ack(101)，从 104 收到 ack(101)。此时，我们重传 101。然后，我们从 105 到 110 收到 ack(101)。最后，我们最终从 101 收到 ack(111)。

blocks.en: At the recipient’s end, we receive 102 through 110, and send back ack(101) each time, since the next unreceived byte is still 101. Eventually, we receive the re-sent 101, and we send back ack(111) because the next unreceived byte is 111.
blocks.zh_html: 在接收方，我们收到 102 到 110，每次都回复 ack(101)，因为下一个未收到的字节仍然是 101。最终，我们收到重传的 101，并回复 ack(111)，因为下一个未收到的字节是 111。

blocks.en: What does CWND look like during this running example? Remember that the window starts at the first unacknowledged byte, and extends for CWND contiguous bytes. The only way to shift the window forward is to receive the first unacked byte. If we receive acks for some other bytes in the window, the window stays the same, because the window is determined by the first unacked byte.
blocks.zh_html: 在这个运行示例中 CWND 是什么样子的？记住，窗口从第一个未确认的字节开始，延伸 CWND 个连续字节。向前移动窗口的唯一方法是收到第一个未确认的字节。如果我们收到窗口中其他字节的 ack，窗口保持不变，因为窗口由第一个未确认的字节决定。

blocks.en: Fast Recovery: The Problem
blocks.zh_html: 快速恢复：问题(Fast Recovery: The Problem)

blocks.en: Let’s assume that CWND starts at 10. Packets 101 through 110 are allowed to be in flight. The sender sends 101 through 110, but 101 is dropped.
blocks.zh_html: 假设 CWND 开始时为 10。分组 101 到 110 被允许在途。发送方发送 101 到 110，但 101 被丢弃。

blocks.en: The sender sees ack(101), generated from the other side receiving 102. At this point, the first unacked byte is still 101, so the window stays unchanged. The only packets allowed to be in flights are still 101 through 110, and the sender cannot send anything new (e.g. 111 can’t be sent).
blocks.zh_html: 发送方看到 ack(101)，由对方收到 102 产生。此时，第一个未确认的字节仍然是 101，因此窗口保持不变。允许在途的分组仍然是 101 到 110，发送方不能发送任何新内容(例如不能发送 111)。

blocks.en: Next, the sender sees ack(101), generated from the other side receiving 103. Again, the first unacked byte is still 101, so the window is unchanged. The window still starts at 101 and extends to 110, and the sender can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，发送方看到 ack(101)，由对方收到 103 产生。同样，第一个未确认的字节仍然是 101，因此窗口不变。窗口仍然从 101 开始延伸到 110，发送方不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: Next, the sender sees ack(101), generated from the other side receiving 104. This is the third duplicate ack, so we must decrease CWND to 5. The first unacked byte is still 101, and CWND is 5, so packets 101 through 105 are allowed to be in flight. The sender still can’t send anything new. We re-send 101 (left-most packet in window) because we saw the third duplicate ack.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，发送方看到 ack(101)，由对方收到 104 产生。这是第三个重复 ack，因此我们必须将 CWND 减小到 5。第一个未确认的字节仍然是 101，CWND 是 5，因此允许在途的分组是 101 到 105。发送方仍然不能发送任何新内容。我们重传 101(窗口中最左侧的分组)，因为我们看到了第三个重复 ack。

blocks.en: Next, the sender sees ack(101), generated from the other side receiving 105. The window is still 101 (first unacked byte) through 105 (CWND bytes later), so we can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，发送方看到 ack(101)，由对方收到 105 产生。窗口仍然是 101(第一个未确认的字节)到 105(CWND 字节之后)，因此我们不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: Next, the sender sees ack(101), generated from the other side receiving 106. Again, the window doesn’t change, and we can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，发送方看到 ack(101)，由对方收到 106 产生。同样，窗口不变，我们不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: The sender gets ack(101), ack(101), ack(101), ack(101) from the other side receiving 107, 108, 109, 110. In every case, 101 is still the first unacked byte, so the window is still 101 through 105, and the sender can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 发送方从对方收到 107、108、109、110 时分别收到 ack(101)、ack(101)、ack(101)、ack(101)。在每种情况下，101 仍然是第一个未确认的字节，因此窗口仍然是 101 到 105，发送方不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: What happened here? Only a single packet was dropped, but as a result, the sender had to completely stop sending for a long time.
blocks.zh_html: 这里发生了什么？只有一个分组被丢弃，但结果是发送方不得不完全停止发送很长时间。

blocks.en: The window is defined by the first unacked byte, so the window refuses to move forward until 101 is re-sent and acked. Even though all the other packets (102 through 110) arrive, the window is still stuck at 101, and later packets (111 onward) can’t be sent. The sender is stalled!
blocks.zh_html: 窗口由第一个未确认的字节定义，因此窗口拒绝向前移动，直到 101 被重传并确认。即使所有其他分组(102 到 110)都已到达，窗口仍然卡在 101，后面的分组(111 及以后)无法发送。发送方停滞了！

blocks.en: Eventually, the sender receives ack(111) from the re-sent 101. This causes the window to leap forward and slide to the new first unacked packet, 111. CWND is still 5, so the sender is now able to send 111 through 115.
blocks.zh_html: 最终，发送方收到重传的 101 的 ack(111)。这导致窗口向前跳跃并滑动到新的第一个未确认分组 111。CWND 仍然是 5，因此发送方现在可以发送 111 到 115。

blocks.en: What happened here? We now have a secondary problem. The sender stalled for a long time, but as soon as 101 was acked with ack(111), the window leapt forward all the way to 111-115, and the sender suddenly has to scramble to send 111-115 all at the same time.
blocks.zh_html: 这里发生了什么？我们现在有了第二个问题。发送方停滞了很长时间，但一旦 101 被确认(ack(111))，窗口就一路跳跃到 111-115，发送方突然不得不匆忙地同时发送 111-115。

blocks.en: The sender stalled for a long time, sending nothing, and then suddenly scrambled to send 111-115 at the same time. Now, the sender has to wait another full round-trip for 111-115 to get acked, before it can send 116 and beyond.
blocks.zh_html: 发送方停滞了很长时间，什么也没发送，然后突然匆忙地同时发送 111-115。现在，发送方必须再等一个完整的往返时间让 111-115 被确认，然后才能发送 116 及之后的分组。

blocks.en: In summary: The isolated packet loss caused the window to get stuck, which causes the sender to stall and send nothing. Eventually, when that packet is re-sent and acked, the window leaps forward, causing the sender to scramble and send a bunch of new packets at once. The sender now has to wait another round-trip for those new packets to get acked, before it can resume business as usual.
blocks.zh_html: 总结：孤立分组丢失导致窗口卡住，进而导致发送方停滞且不发送任何内容。最终，当该分组被重传并确认后，窗口向前跳跃，导致发送方匆忙地同时发送一堆新分组。发送方现在必须再等一个往返时间让这些新分组被确认，然后才能恢复正常发送。

blocks.en: A few notes about this problem:
blocks.zh_html: 关于这个问题的几点说明：

blocks.en: If the problem is still kind of hard to grasp, it might help to note that this problem is more due to the TCP sliding window scheme, and not really due to the congestion control scheme. Congestion control causes the window to shrink, but even if the window didn’t shrink, the sender would still be forced to stall until 101 is received and the window leaps forward.
blocks.zh_html: 如果这个问题仍然有点难以理解，不妨注意这个问题更多地是由于 TCP 滑动窗口机制造成的，而不是由于拥塞控制机制。拥塞控制导致窗口缩小，但即使窗口不缩小，发送方也仍然会被迫停滞，直到 101 被收到且窗口向前跳跃。

blocks.en: When we think about this problem intuitively, it helps to draw the diagrams of the sender’s window, marking off the bytes that have been acked. For example, after the triple duplicate acks, we mark 102, 103, 104 as received, and the window allows 101 (first unacked byte) through 105 to be in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们直观地思考这个问题时，画出发送方窗口的图示、标记已被确认的字节会有帮助。例如，在三个重复 ack 之后，我们标记 102、103、104 为已收到，窗口允许 101(第一个未确认的字节)到 105 在途。

blocks.en: However, this isn’t really what the sender sees. Remember, the sender only sees cumulative acks, so it doesn’t actually know that 102, 103, and 104 were received. The sender can deduce that 3 packets in the window (that are not 101) were received, but it doesn’t know which 3 packets exactly.
blocks.zh_html: 然而，这并不是发送方实际看到的情况。记住，发送方只看到累积 ack(cumulative acks)，所以它实际上不知道 102、103 和 104 已被收到。发送方可以推断出窗口中有 3 个分组(不是 101)已被收到，但它不知道具体是哪 3 个分组。

blocks.en: Finally, note that after we get 3 duplicate ack(101) messages, we re-send 101, and we never re-send 101 again, even if more duplicate ack(101) messages come in. This is just the TCP rule for re-sending on duplicate acks.
blocks.zh_html: 最后，注意在收到 3 个重复 ack(101)消息后，我们重传 101，即使更多重复 ack(101)消息到达，也不会再次重传 101。这只是 TCP 关于重复 ack 重传的规则。

blocks.en: Fast Recovery: The Idea
blocks.zh_html: 快速恢复：思路(Fast Recovery: The Idea)

blocks.en: So, how do we solve this problem? Ideally, we don’t want the sender to stall, and we want the sender to keep sending later packets (111 onwards), even if 101 gets lost.
blocks.zh_html: 那么，我们如何解决这个问题？理想情况下，我们不希望发送方停滞，我们希望发送方继续发送后面的分组(111 及以后)，即使 101 丢失了。

blocks.en: Notice that even though the sender can’t deduce exactly which packets arrive, the sender can deduce that later (non-101) packets are getting received.
blocks.zh_html: 注意，尽管发送方不能确切推断出哪些分组到达了，但发送方可以推断出后面的(非 101)分组正在被接收。

blocks.en: When we see ack(101), generated from 102 being received, we don’t actually know that 102 was received, but we know some packet (non-101) got received. Therefore, only 9 packets remain in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们看到由收到 102 产生的 ack(101)时，我们实际上不知道 102 已被收到，但我们知道某个分组(非 101)已被收到。因此，只有 9 个分组仍在途。

blocks.en: When we see another ack(101), generated from 103 being received, we again don’t know that 103 specifically was received, but we know that another packet (non-101) got received. Therefore, only 8 packets remain in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们看到另一个由收到 103 产生的 ack(101)时，我们同样不知道 103 具体已被收到，但我们知道另一个分组(非 101)已被收到。因此，只有 8 个分组仍在途。

blocks.en: As we keep receiving duplicate ack(101) messages, we can deduce that fewer packets remain in flight:
blocks.zh_html: 随着我们不断收到重复 ack(101)消息，我们可以推断出仍在途的分组越来越少：

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 102: 9 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 102 的 ack(101)后：9 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 103: 8 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 103 的 ack(101)后：8 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 104: 7 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 104 的 ack(101)后：7 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 105: 6 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 105 的 ack(101)后：6 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 106: 5 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 106 的 ack(101)后：5 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 107: 4 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 107 的 ack(101)后：4 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 108: 3 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 108 的 ack(101)后：3 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 109: 2 packets in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 109 的 ack(101)后：2 个分组在途。

blocks.en: After ack(101) from 110: 1 packet in flight.
blocks.zh_html: 收到来自 110 的 ack(101)后：1 个分组在途。

blocks.en: Eventually, after we get ack(101) nine times (from 102 through 110 being received), we know that only 1 packet remains in flight, namely 101.
blocks.zh_html: 最终，在我们收到九次 ack(101)(从 102 到 110 被收到)后，我们知道只有 1 个分组仍在途，即 101。

blocks.en: After the isolated loss, we really want CWND to be 5, which means we want 5 packets in flight at any given time. By the time we get ack(101) from 107, we can deduce that only 4 packets remain in flight. (In reality, they are 101, 108, 109, 110, though the sender doesn’t know that.)
blocks.zh_html: 在孤立丢失之后，我们真正希望 CWND 为 5，这意味着我们希望在任何时刻有 5 个分组在途。到我们从 107 收到 ack(101)时，我们可以推断出只有 4 个分组仍在途。(实际上它们是 101、108、109、110，尽管发送方不知道。)

blocks.en: At this point, we’d like to be able to send 111, for a total of 5 packets in flight. But the window won’t let us do that, because the window is still stuck at 101 (first unacked byte) through 105 (CWND bytes later).
blocks.zh_html: 此时，我们希望可以发送 111，使总共 5 个分组在途。但窗口不允许我们这样做，因为窗口仍然卡在 101(第一个未确认的字节)到 105(CWND 字节之后)。

blocks.en: The key idea that will un-stall the sender is: Let’s grant the sender temporary credit for each duplicate ack.
blocks.zh_html: 解除发送方停滞的关键思路是：让每个重复 ack 为发送方提供临时信用(credit)。

blocks.en: When a duplicate ack arrives, we can deduce that one fewer packet is in flight, though we don’t know which one. To account for this, we will artificially extend the window by 1 packet, to allow the sender to send one more packet.
blocks.zh_html: 当重复 ack 到达时，我们可以推断出在途分组减少了一个，尽管我们不知道是哪一个。为了应对这一点，我们将人为地将窗口扩展 1 个分组，以允许发送方多发送一个分组。

blocks.en: Fast Recovery: The Solution
blocks.zh_html: 快速恢复：解决方案(Fast Recovery: The Solution)

blocks.en: Let’s take this idea of artificially extending the window for each duplicate ack, and apply it to the example from before.
blocks.zh_html: 让我们把这个为每个重复 ack 人为扩展窗口的思路应用到之前的例子中。

blocks.en: As before, the window starts at 101 through 110, and we send out 10 packets.
blocks.zh_html: 和之前一样，窗口从 101 到 110，我们发送 10 个分组。

blocks.en: As before, we get ack(101) from 102, the window stays unchanged, and we can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 和之前一样，我们从 102 收到 ack(101)，窗口保持不变，我们不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: As before, we get ack(101) from 103, the window stays unchanged, and we can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 和之前一样，我们从 103 收到 ack(101)，窗口保持不变，我们不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: As before, we get ack(101) from 104, the window stays unchanged, and we can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 和之前一样，我们从 104 收到 ack(101)，窗口保持不变，我们不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: The third duplicate ack means we decrease CWND to 5, so the window is now 101 through 105.
blocks.zh_html: 第三个重复 ack 意味着我们将 CWND 减小到 5，因此窗口现在是 101 到 105。

blocks.en: However, we got 3 acks, so we artificially extend the window by 3 to account for those acks. Thus, CWND is actually set to 5 + 3 = 8.
blocks.zh_html: 然而，我们收到了 3 个 ack，所以我们人为地将窗口扩展 3 以计入这些 ack。因此，CWND 实际设为 5 + 3 = 8。

blocks.en: Next, we get ack(101) from 105. This allows us to extend the window again, to 9. Now the window spans 101 through 109, so we still can’t send new packets.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们从 105 收到 ack(101)。这让我们再次扩展窗口，到 9。现在窗口覆盖 101 到 109，所以我们仍然不能发送新分组。

blocks.en: Next, we get ack(101) from 106. We extend the window again to 10, spanning 101 through 110, and we can’t send anything new.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们从 106 收到 ack(101)。我们再次扩展窗口到 10，覆盖 101 到 110，我们不能发送任何新内容。

blocks.en: Next, we get ack(101) from 107. We extend the window again to 11, spanning 101 through 111. We can now send out 111!
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们从 107 收到 ack(101)。我们再次扩展窗口到 11，覆盖 101 到 111。我们现在可以发送 111 了！

blocks.en: Next, we get ack(101) from 108. We extend the window again to 12, spanning 101 through 112. We can now send out 112!
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们从 108 收到 ack(101)。我们再次扩展窗口到 12，覆盖 101 到 112。我们现在可以发送 112 了！

blocks.en: Next, we get ack(101) from 109. We extend the window again to 13, spanning 101 through 113. We can now send out 113!
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们从 109 收到 ack(101)。我们再次扩展窗口到 13，覆盖 101 到 113。我们现在可以发送 113 了！

blocks.en: Next, we get ack(101) from 110. We extend the window again to 14, spanning 101 through 114. We can now send out 114!
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们从 110 收到 ack(101)。我们再次扩展窗口到 14，覆盖 101 到 114。我们现在可以发送 114 了！

blocks.en: Eventually, we get ack(111) from the re-sent 101. At this point, we can reset CWND to its original intended value of 5, so that the window spans 111 through 115. This allows us to send out 115!
blocks.zh_html: 最终，我们收到重传的 101 的 ack(111)。此时，我们可以将 CWND 重置为原本想要的值 5，这样窗口覆盖 111 到 115。这让我们可以发送 115！

blocks.en: With this fix, we have solved our problem of the stalled sender. Originally, the sender had to wait for the re-sent 101 to be acked before sending new packets. Now, the sender is now able to keep sending packets before the re-sent 101 is acked.
blocks.zh_html: 通过这个修复，我们解决了发送方停滞的问题。原来，发送方必须等待重传的 101 被确认后才能发送新分组。现在，发送方能够在重传的 101 被确认之前继续发送分组。

blocks.en: We also solved the secondary problem from earlier, where the window leapt forward and we sent a burst of new packets (111 through 115). Now, 111 through 114 were sent out earlier, and when the window leapt forward, we only had to send out 115.
blocks.zh_html: 我们还解决了之前的第二个问题，即窗口向前跳跃时我们发送了一突发新分组(111 到 115)。现在，111 到 114 已经提前发送了出去，当窗口向前跳跃时，我们只需要发送 115。

blocks.en: Without this fix, we had to stall for another round-trip while waiting for the burst of 111 through 115 to be acked. Now, because we stayed busy earlier and sent out 111 through 114, they’ll get acked earlier, and we can keep sending 116 and beyond without that entire RTT of stalling.
blocks.zh_html: 没有这个修复，我们不得不再停滞一个往返时间，等待 111 到 115 这一突发被确认。现在，因为我们提前保持了忙碌并发送了 111 到 114，它们会更早被确认，我们可以继续发送 116 及之后的分组，而无需浪费整个 RTT 的停滞。

blocks.en: Another way to look at this fix is to focus on the packets in the artificially-extended window.
blocks.zh_html: 看待这个修复的另一种方式是关注人为扩展窗口中的分组。

blocks.en: When we get the third duplicate ack, the CWND shrinks to 5, but we artificially extend for the 3 duplicate acks for a CWND of 8. If you look at this extended window, 3 of the packets are acked (102, 103, 104, though we don’t know it’s these), and the other 5 are in-flight. This achieves our intended window of 5 packets in-flight.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们收到第三个重复 ack 时，CWND 缩小到 5，但我们为 3 个重复 ack 人为扩展，得到 CWND 为 8。如果看看这个扩展窗口，其中 3 个分组已被确认(102、103、104，尽管我们不知道是这些)，另外 5 个在途。这实现了我们期望的 5 个分组在途的窗口。

blocks.en: Next, when we get another ack(101) from 105, the window extends to 9. Again, if you look in this window, 4 of the packets are acked (we don’t know which), and the other 5 are in-flight, giving us our intended window of 5 in-flight packets.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，当我们从 105 收到另一个 ack(101)时，窗口扩展到 9。同样，如果看这个窗口，其中 4 个分组已被确认(我们不知道是哪 4 个)，另外 5 个在途，实现了我们期望的 5 个在途分组的窗口。

blocks.en: When we get ack(101) from 106, the window extends to 10, including 5 received packets (from 5 duplicate acks), plus 5 in-flight packets (intended window size).
blocks.zh_html: 当我们从 106 收到 ack(101)时，窗口扩展到 10，包括 5 个已收到的分组(来自 5 个重复 ack)，加上 5 个在途分组(期望的窗口大小)。

blocks.en: At every step, in our extended window, if you don’t count the packets that have been acked, there are exactly 5 packets in-flight in the window. Again, we don’t know exactly which packets in the window are acked, but we can use the duplicate acks to count how many packets were acked, and use that count to keep 5 in-flight packets.
blocks.zh_html: 在每一步中，在我们的扩展窗口里，如果不计算已被确认的分组，窗口中正好有 5 个分组在途。同样，我们不知道窗口中具体哪些分组已被确认，但我们可以用重复 ack 来计数有多少分组已被确认，并用这个计数来保持 5 个在途分组。

blocks.en: When we get ack(101) from 107, the window extends to 11, including 6 received packets (from 6 duplicate acks). The other 5 packets in the window are allowed to be in-flight.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们从 107 收到 ack(101)时，窗口扩展到 11，包括 6 个已收到的分组(来自 6 个重复 ack)。窗口中其他 5 个分组允许在途。

blocks.en: At this point, we sent 10 packets originally, and we got 6 duplicate acks, which tells us that only 4 packets remain in flight. This allows us to send out 111. The artificially-extending window captures this reasoning, because it extends the window to include 111.
blocks.zh_html: 此时，我们最初发送了 10 个分组，收到了 6 个重复 ack，这告诉我们只有 4 个分组仍在途。这让我们可以发送 111。人为扩展窗口抓住了这一推理，因为它扩展窗口以包含 111。

blocks.en: When we get ack(101) from 108, we deduce that now, one fewer packet is in flight. So we artificially extend the window again to 12, which allows 112 to be sent.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们从 108 收到 ack(101)时，我们推断现在在途分组又少了一个。所以我们再次人为扩展窗口到 12，这允许发送 112。

blocks.en: Fast Recovery: Implementation
blocks.zh_html: 快速恢复：实现(Fast Recovery: Implementation)

blocks.en: When we detect packet loss from duplicate acks, we temporarily enter the fast recovery mode, where additional duplicate acks artificially extend the window to prevent stalling.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们从重复 ack 检测到分组丢失时，我们暂时进入快速恢复(fast recovery)模式，在此模式下额外的重复 ack 会人为扩展窗口以防止停滞。

blocks.en: Fast recovery mode is triggered when we receive 3 duplicate acks. Instead of just halving CWND, as we did before, we now set CWND to CWND/2 + 3, where the window is artificially extended by 3 for the 3 duplicate acks we got. We also set SSTHRESH to CWND/2, so that we remember the new safe rate for later.
blocks.zh_html: 快速恢复模式在我们收到 3 个重复 ack 时触发。与之前直接将 CWND 减半不同，我们现在将 CWND 设为 CWND/2 + 3，其中窗口为收到的 3 个重复 ack 人为扩展了 3。我们还将 SSTHRESH 设为 CWND/2，以便记住之后的新安全速率。

blocks.en: While in fast recovery mode, every additional duplicate ack causes CWND to increase by 1, allowing the window to artificially extend.
blocks.zh_html: 在快速恢复模式中，每多一个重复 ack 都会使 CWND 增加 1，允许窗口人为扩展。

blocks.en: Eventually, when we receive a new, non-duplicate ack, we leave fast recovery mode and set CWND to SSTHRESH. Note that while we were artificially extending the window, SSTHRESH always helped us remember the original halved rate that we want to ultimately send at.
blocks.zh_html: 最终，当我们收到一个新的非重复 ack 时，我们退出快速恢复模式并将 CWND 设为 SSTHRESH。注意，在我们人为扩展窗口的过程中，SSTHRESH 始终帮助我们记住最初减半的速率，即我们最终希望使用的发送速率。

blocks.en: TCP State Machine
blocks.zh_html: TCP 状态机(TCP State Machine)

blocks.en: We are finally ready to put all the pieces together and implement TCP, with congestion control.
blocks.zh_html: 我们终于准备好把所有部分拼在一起，实现包含拥塞控制的 TCP。

blocks.en: The sender maintains 5 values:
blocks.zh_html: 发送方维护 5 个值：

blocks.en: The duplicate ack count helps us detect loss earlier than timeouts. It’s initialized to 0.
blocks.zh_html: 重复 ack 计数(duplicate ack count)：帮助我们比超时更早检测到丢失。初始化为 0。

blocks.en: The timer is used to detect loss. There’s just a single timer.
blocks.zh_html: 定时器(timer)：用于检测丢失。只有一个定时器。

blocks.en: RWND is used for flow control (don’t overwhelm recipient buffer).
blocks.zh_html: RWND：用于流量控制(flow control，不让接收方缓冲区过载)。

blocks.en: CWND is used for congestion control. It’s initialized to 1 packet.
blocks.zh_html: CWND：用于拥塞控制(congestion control)。初始化为 1 个分组。

blocks.en: SSTHRESH helps the congestion control algorithm remember the latest safe rate. It’s initialized to infinity.
blocks.zh_html: SSTHRESH：帮助拥塞控制算法记住最新的安全速率。初始化为无穷大。

blocks.en: The recipient maintains a buffer of out-of-order packets.
blocks.zh_html: 接收方维护一个乱序分组的缓冲区(buffer)。

blocks.en: The sender responds to 3 events: Ack for new data (not previously acked), duplicate ack, and timeout.
blocks.zh_html: 发送方响应 3 个事件：新数据的 Ack(之前未确认)、重复 ack 和超时。

blocks.en: The recipient responds to receiving a packet, by replying with an ack and a RWND value.
blocks.zh_html: 接收方响应收到的分组，回复一个 ack 和一个 RWND 值。

blocks.en: Let’s see how the sender responds to each of the 3 events.
blocks.zh_html: 让我们看看发送方如何响应这 3 个事件。

blocks.en: When we receive an ack for new data, not previously acked: If in slow-start mode, we increase CWND by 1. This allows the CWND to double each RTT. If we’re in fast-recovery mode, we set CWND to SSTHRESH, so that we leave fast recovery (since we just got a new ack). If we’re in congestion avoidance mode, we add 1/CWND to CWND, so that CWND increases by 1 per RTT (additive increase). We also reset the timer, reset the duplicate ack count, and, if the window allows, send new data.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们收到新数据(之前未确认)的 ack 时：如果在慢启动模式，CWND 增加 1。这使 CWND 每 RTT 翻倍。如果在快速恢复模式，我们将 CWND 设为 SSTHRESH，从而退出快速恢复(因为我们刚收到一个新 ack)。如果在拥塞避免(congestion avoidance)模式，我们将 CWND 加上 1/CWND，使 CWND 每 RTT 增加 1(加法增加)。我们还重置定时器、重置重复 ack 计数，并且在窗口允许的情况下发送新数据。

blocks.en: When we receive a duplicate ack, we increment the duplicate ack count. If the count reaches 3, we re-send the left-most packet in the window. This is sometimes called fast retransmit. We also enter fast-recovery mode by setting SSTHRESH to CWND/2 (remember last safe rate) and set CWND to CWND/2 + 3 (adding 3 to artifically extend the window for duplicate acks). If the count exceeds 3, we stay in fast-recovery mode and artificially extend the CWND by 1 for every subsequent duplicate ack.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们收到重复 ack 时，重复 ack 计数加 1。如果计数达到 3，我们重传窗口中最左侧的分组。这有时称为快速重传(fast retransmit)。我们还将 SSTHRESH 设为 CWND/2(记住最后的安全速率)，并将 CWND 设为 CWND/2 + 3(加 3 以为重复 ack 人为扩展窗口)，从而进入快速恢复模式。如果计数超过 3，我们保持在快速恢复模式，并且每收到一个后续重复 ack，CWND 人为增加 1。

blocks.en: When the timer expires, we re-send the left-most packet in the window. We also go back to slow-start mode, setting SSTHRESH to CWND/2 (remembering the last safe rate), and resetting CWND back to 1 packet.
blocks.zh_html: 当定时器到期时，我们重传窗口中最左侧的分组。我们还回到慢启动模式，将 SSTHRESH 设为 CWND/2(记住最后的安全速率)，并将 CWND 重置回 1 个分组。

blocks.en: The congestion control state machine shows the 3 possible modes that TCP can be in, and the conditions that trigger transitions between the modes.
blocks.zh_html: 拥塞控制状态机(state machine)展示了 TCP 可能处于的 3 种模式，以及触发模式间转换的条件。

blocks.en: We enter fast-recovery mode if we receive 3 duplicate acks. Once we’re in this mode, any further duplicate acks keep us in fast-recovery mode (keep artificially extending window). To leave fast-recovery mode, either a timeout switches us back to slow-start mode, or a new ack lets us go back to congestion-avoidance mode.
blocks.zh_html: 如果我们收到 3 个重复 ack，就进入快速恢复模式。一旦进入此模式，任何后续重复 ack 都会让我们保持在快速恢复模式(持续人为扩展窗口)。要退出快速恢复模式，要么超时将我们切换回慢启动模式，要么新 ack 让我们回到拥塞避免模式。

blocks.en: A timeout triggers slow-start mode. Any further acks (duplicate or new) keep us in slow-start. Eventually, if CWND exceeds SSTHRESH (the safe rate), we enter congestion avoidance mode. Or, if we detect loss, we halve the rate and enter fast-recovery mode for a bit before going to congestion-avoidance mode.
blocks.zh_html: 超时触发慢启动模式。任何后续 ack(重复或新)让我们保持在慢启动。最终，如果 CWND 超过 SSTHRESH(安全速率)，我们进入拥塞避免模式。或者，如果检测到丢失，我们将速率减半并短暂进入快速恢复模式，然后进入拥塞避免模式。

blocks.en: In congestion avoidance mode, new acks keep us in this mode (additive increase), but duplicate acks send us to fast-recovery mode, and timeouts send us to slow-start mode.
blocks.zh_html: 在拥塞避免模式中，新 ack 让我们保持在此模式(加法增加)，但重复 ack 将我们送入快速恢复模式，超时将我们送入慢启动模式。

blocks.en: TCP Congestion Control Variants
blocks.zh_html: TCP 拥塞控制变体(TCP Congestion Control Variants)

blocks.en: There are several variants of the TCP congestion control algorithm, all implemented in the end host’s operating system. Fun fact: The names are related to the Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) operating system.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 拥塞控制算法有多个变体，都在端主机的操作系统中实现。趣闻：名称与伯克利软件发行版(Berkeley Software Distribution, BSD)操作系统有关。

blocks.en: In TCP Tahoe, if we get three duplicate acks, we reset CWND to 1, instead of halving CWND.
blocks.zh_html: 在 TCP Tahoe 中，如果收到三个重复 ack，我们将 CWND 重置为 1，而不是减半。

blocks.en: In TCP Reno, if we get three duplicate acks, we halve CWND. On timeout, we reset CWND to 1.
blocks.zh_html: 在 TCP Reno 中，如果收到三个重复 ack，我们将 CWND 减半。超时时，将 CWND 重置为 1。

blocks.en: TCP New Reno is the same as Reno, but adds fast recovery. This is what we just implemented.
blocks.zh_html: TCP New Reno 与 Reno 相同，但增加了快速恢复(fast recovery)。这就是我们刚刚实现的内容。

blocks.en: Other variants exist too. In TCP-SACK, we add selective acknowledgments where acks contain more detail (e.g. received all up to 13, and 18 too).
blocks.zh_html: 还有其他变体。在 TCP-SACK 中，我们增加了选择性确认(selective acknowledgments)，其中 ack 包含更多细节(例如，已收到截至 13 的所有内容，以及 18)。

blocks.en: How can all these different variants co-exist? Why don’t we need a single uniform protocol that everybody speaks? Remember, congestion control is implemented at the end hosts, so the sender can do whatever they want to adjust their rate. Ultimately, the network and the other end hosts just see TCP packets being sent at a (hopefully reasonable) rate, and they don’t care how the rate is being computed. The underlying TCP packet format doesn’t change with the different congestion control algorithms.
blocks.zh_html: 所有这些不同的变体如何共存？为什么不需要一个所有人都使用的统一协议？记住，拥塞控制在端主机上实现，因此发送方可以做任何它们想做的事情来调整速率。最终，网络和其他端主机只看到 TCP 分组以(希望是合理的)速率被发送，它们并不关心速率是如何计算的。底层的 TCP 分组格式不会因不同的拥塞控制算法而改变。

blocks.en: Not all protocols are compatible, though. If you use the TCP-SACK variant with selective acknowledgements, and I use TCP Tahoe, we have a problem. You expect selective acks, but I’m only providing cumulative acks.
blocks.zh_html: 不过，并非所有协议都兼容。如果你使用带选择性确认的 TCP-SACK 变体，而我使用 TCP Tahoe，就会出现问题。你期望选择性 ack，但我只提供累积 ack(cumulative acks)。
